outcome.successDescription: Your satellite survived the mission and delivered the required imagery.
outcome.failureDescription: Review the mission log to see which decisions shaped the outcome.
help.title: Your mission, one orbit at a time.
help.goal: Keep the satellite alive for all 10 orbits and downlink 10,000 Mb of useful imagery.
help.switches: Set the four switches before each orbit. They give systems permission to work automatically in their assigned windows.
help.camera: The camera fills onboard memory. A full buffer discards new imagery.
help.transmitter: The transmitter empties memory only during a ground pass. Captured data counts toward the objective only after it reaches Earth.
help.heater: The heater protects the camera in eclipse. Two unheated eclipses can cold-lock the instrument until it warms up.
help.safeMode: Safe mode pauses imaging and downlink, keeps available heating on, and gives your panels a chance to recharge the battery.
help.forecast: Read the forecast before committing. Solar storms reduce power generation and downlink speed for one orbit.
help.timing: Nothing advances until you run the next orbit. Take your time to plan.
ui.tagline: Keep it alive. Bring the data home.
ui.loadoutHint: Loadouts come from the existing module catalog. Choosing one starts a new mission.
ui.preset.balanced.description: Medium systems. A reliable first mission.
ui.preset.comms.description: Small antenna. Watch your memory fill up.
ui.preset.power.description: Small arrays and battery, damaged power. Prepare for the storm.

ui.successDescription: Your satellite completed {turns} orbits and delivered {delivered} Mb of imagery.
ui.failureDescription: Survived {turns} of {total} orbits. Delivered {delivered} Mb. Review the causes in the mission log.
ui.helpGoal: Survive all 10 orbits and deliver 10,000 Mb of useful Earth imagery.
ui.helpOne: Set your systems. The camera fills memory, the transmitter sends it to Earth, and the heater protects the instrument in eclipse.
ui.helpTwo: Read the forecast. Check the ending battery charge and discarded data before committing. Storms reduce solar generation and downlink for one orbit.
ui.helpThree: Advance one orbit at a time. Safe mode pauses imaging and downlink while preserving heating. Use Change loadout to try a different spacecraft.
ui.demoDisclaimer: This playable prototype starts after satellite separation, with a full battery. It uses the repository catalog and a simplified orbital schedule. The original debug game is available separately.
